commercial_incentive: yes - promotes InGenius Prep consulting, blog, and YouTube subscriptions at the end
key_insights: If a student has more than 10 activities for the Common App list, similar activities (e.g., varsity and club soccer) should be combined into one entry rather than listed separately
The additional information section should only be used for essential details, such as research or publications, not simply to list extra activities
Students can flag 'see additional info' in brackets within an activity description to point admissions readers to more detail elsewhere in the application
Hours-per-week and weeks-per-year fields should be used to convey time commitment rather than trying to convey variety
The number of activities listed does not matter to admissions offices; quality of involvement matters more than quantity
notable_or_distinctive: Gives a concrete worked example (combining varsity/club soccer) for how to consolidate overlapping activities within the Common App's 10-slot limit.
reliability_notes: Short, generic consultancy advice video with no data or citations; framed partly as a promotional piece for the presenter's admissions consulting company.
